name: Survey tile in Libra
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.1 degrees north of the ecliptic in Libra, imaged by SPHEREx 19 times in 7 visits over 60 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 40 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.5 days starting 2026-07-13, at wavelengths from 1.11 to 4.98 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
